name: agent-audit-config
description: Audit a deliberately flawed Claude Code agent setup against a local best-practices reference.
prompt: Audit the agent configuration in this repository against docs/latest-best-practices.md. Write the full audit report and implementation plan to artifacts/agent-audit-report.md. Do not modify the existing configuration files.

expected.description: Writes the audit into a deterministic report artifact
Uses the documented audit report structure with a score and priority-ordered recommendations
Flags the overly broad reviewer agent configuration
Calls out the conflicting review rules

falsePositives.description: Should not rewrite the audited agent config while producing the report
Should not claim the configuration is already up to date
contentIncludes: All clear — configuration is up to date
